title: Chapter 223: The Evildoer Xiao Yin
content:
Chapter 223: The Evildoer Xiao Yin

"All of you are going to die!!"

A peak-level strong man from the Xiao clan roared.

Suddenly, the three tribes present had a reaction.

Now the Xiao clan is no longer the one who is in a crisis of genocide, but the three clans have become them.

"Retreat, retreat quickly!"

The Ye clan leader shouted, then he turned around and retreated rapidly regardless of his prestige. The speed was extremely fast, and the void passed by began to move violently.

Seeing this, the other three tribes turned around and fled.

When the disaster comes, everyone flies.

What kind of alliance of three races is nothing but bullshit in the face of absolute strength.

Seeing that the people from the three tribes fled to the Xiao tribe, the strong men of the Xiao tribe did not choose to let them go.

"Chasing! I dare to attack me, even if I escape to the ends of the world, I will vow to make you pay the price!"

Immediately, the thirty-six strong men in the void rushed out of the thirty strong men and chased the three tribes who had already escaped, shaking the void.

Because there is too much movement here, the entire fairyland has already felt the breath here.

"Where is that? What a strong breath."

Someone looked at the direction of the Xiao clan with a serious expression and said with some lingering fear.

The feeling that the breath gave him was even more terrifying than the strongest person in the Immortal Emperor realm.

The rest of the people were the same, all of whom stopped what was in their hands and looked in that direction.

I saw dark clouds there, the void was turbulent, as if some great terror had just been born.

At this time, the knowledgeable cultivator stepped forward and said, "That is the ancient Xiao clan."

"Ancient Xiao clan?"

Everyone present was a little confused.

Obviously, this name is basically unknown.

"Fellow Taoist, I don't know what kind of power the ancient Xiao clan is, and why such a terrifying aura was heard."

A young man who looked a little elegantly stepped forward and asked politely.

Hearing this, the great monk held his hands with one hand and said solemnly: "This ancient Xiao clan has a big background, but it has not appeared in the eyes of the world for a long time, so it is not very famous now."

"But if you mention a person, you will know."

"who?"

Everyone asked in unison.

"Xiao Yin."

The great monk said indifferently.

Suddenly, everyone was shocked. Although they were already a person from millions of years ago, almost no one dared to forget this name.

A peerless genius who dominated the list of the Immortal Realm Monsters millions of years ago.

All the geniuses of that era were eclipsed, and they could only look up at their backs.

Until now, Xiao Yin's name is still engraved in the Tiandi Academy and is admired by later generations.

"No wonder, how could that kind of monster have no background?"

Although Xiao Yin was just a flash in the pan of the history of the fairyland, people still feel sorry for it.

Since then, the name of the ancient Xiao clan has also re-entered the eyes of the world.

At the same time, countless powerful people from the Immortal Realm headed towards the ancient Xiao clan, wanting to find out.

These people have a good status in the Immortal Realm and are very aware of the current situation of the Xiao clan over the years.

But now, the Xiao clan does not seem to be what they thought.

Inside the Xiao clan.

In addition to the thirty strong men of the Xiao clan who were chasing the three tribes, six strong men were left to guard the Xiao clan.

Among them are Xiao Mo and Xiao Yin, the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

"Everyone, don't be fine."

Xiao Mo smiled and fell from the void to the ground, then walked slowly towards Xiao Jing and the others.

"Class leader!"

Suddenly, everyone rushed forward, crying and laughing.

Xiao Mo comforted everyone.

"Okay, with me waiting, Xiao clan has no worries."

At this moment, everyone looked at Xiao Yin who was quietly looking at Xiao Mo.

This is the pride of their Xiao clan back then.

"Child, it's great to see you're still alive."

Xiao Jing and the elders of the Xiao clan looked at Xiao Yin with tears in their eyes.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Yin's eyes were also slightly red.

Xiao Yin slowly bent down towards Xiao Jing and others and said, "Uncles, I'm sorry, if I hadn't been determined to do my own thing back then, you wouldn't have suffered so much."

For the past million years in the ancestral land of the Xiao clan, Xiao Yin has been in self-blame all the time.

The Xiao clan was in dire straits, but she could only continue to practice in the ancestral land and could not do anything for the Xiao clan. She even thought that when she was about to die, she would definitely rush out of the ancestral land.

Because she has not made any contribution to the Xiao clan and is not qualified to be buried in her ancestral land.

Hearing Xiao Yin's words, Xiao Jing and others shook their heads slightly.

"Child, it's not your fault."

"Yes, it's all over."

Xiao Jing helped Xiao Yin up, and everyone on the side also comforted her.

"Senior Xiao Yin."

At this moment, a voice sounded from behind everyone.

Everyone looked back.

I saw Xiao Luo running quickly towards here.

"Luoer."

When Xiao Luo saw Xiao Mo immediately stepped forward.

"grandfather."

Looking at Xiao Mo in front of him, Xiao Luo showed a long-lasting smile.

"Luoer, shouldn't you be in the academy? Why are you back?"

At this time, Xiao Mo remembered something and frowned.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo looked embarrassed.

After a moment.

"You bastard, are you stupid?!"

Xiao Mo stared at Xiao Luo with a look of regret, and actually ran back to share life and death with his family, which was beyond the reach of foolishness.

Although he was yelling and cursing, there was a hint of relief in Xiao Mo's eyes.

This is the real man of the Xiao clan.

He Xiao Mo's grandson.

However, the family's life and death should still focus on the overall situation.

Seeing what else he wanted to say, Xiao Luo quickly took out the Xiao clan's small tower, "Grandpa, everyone is here."

Seeing this, Xiao Mo was slightly stunned, then he snorted coldly and stopped talking.

Xiao Luo shrank his neck and then came to Xiao Yin.

"Senior Xiao Yin."

When Xiao Luo saw Xiao Yin, he was obviously a little excited.

Since I was born, I grew up listening to Xiao Yin's legend.

After stepping into the Immortal Lord's Realm at the age of 100,000, the President of the Tiandi Academy came to the Xiao clan and brought Xiao Yin into the academy.

Defeat the genius and tame the immortal beasts.

Killing through the list of monsters, and defeating all monsters in the fairyland.

He also gained some knowledge of the Immortal Emperor's scriptures in the Immortal Lord Realm, and shocked the Immortal Realm again.

Everything about Xiao Yin is deeply engraved in the hearts of the world, as if telling the world that the Xiao clan is not yet in despair.

Xiao Luo also regarded Xiao Yin as his idol.

From now on, we strive to achieve success, and hope that one day we can reach Xiao Yin's height.

Now, when seeing Xiao Yin himself, how could Xiao Luo not be excited?

Looking at Xiao Luo in front of him, Xiao Yin also smiled.

"No need to be so arrogant. By seniority, just call me Sister Yin."

Upon hearing this, Xiao Luo was immediately embarrassed.

But he still called Sister Yin.

On the side, Xiao Mo, who saw this scene, stepped forward and said, "Xiao Yin, what do you think of my grandson?"

In the ancestral land, Xiao Mo told Xiao Yin that he had a grandson outside and had a very good talent.

If I can go out one day, I hope I can entrust her to help bring the area.
